# Theme Report

Generated 2026-10-29. Each theme in `themes.json` is applied to 10 real Tabler pages at 1366×768.
Every visible text element is measured against WCAG 2.1 AA (normal text ≥ 4.5:1, large text ≥ 3:1). Screenshots: `captures/<theme>/`.

Ad Astra uses **semantic colours only** (primary, secondary, success, warning, danger, info). Failures on Tabler's demo palette
(`btn-yellow`, `text-red`, `bg-azure-lt` …) are counted separately and do not fail the check.
